ABOUT ECHO HOLLOW

A place for memories to stay.

Echo Hollow connects experiences through place and time, without asking people to perform a public identity.

✦ PLACE FIRST · IDENTITY SECOND

Echo Hollow is a place-based memory exchange for people who are visiting, arriving, passing through, or still forming a relationship with a city.

Users can leave a thought, travel note, local discovery, or message for another time. Other people may encounter those memories later through the website or an Echo Hollow terminal in the same place.
HOW IT WORKS

Leave, discover, return.

Write a message with an optional place or image. Discover memories connected to other people and moments. Future messages can stay hidden until their release date.

SAFETY & PRIVACY

Anonymous by design.

Preset identities, optional location detail, anonymous comments and place-focused image review keep attention on shared experiences rather than personal profiles. Images with identifiable faces are not accepted.

WHAT BELONGS HERE

Memories, travel notes and small discoveries.

Echo Hollow is not a conventional travel feed. A useful post leaves a trace of what a place felt like, what someone noticed, or what another visitor might want to find later.

PARTNER WITH ECHO HOLLOW

Bring a memory point to your space.

Echo Hollow grows through a network of public partners and local hosts. Larger public terminals create visible civic memory points, while compact local terminals bring the network into everyday neighbourhood spaces.

PHASE 01

Public launch partners

Early deployments focus on high-traffic civic, cultural, education and community locations through councils, social organisations, universities and large venues.

PHASE 02

Local host network

Compact terminals can later be hosted by cafés, bookstores and independent businesses. Echo Hollow provides the device free of charge, helping the network grow through everyday neighbourhood spaces.

HOSTING MODEL

Different support for different hosts

Public and institutional partners work with Echo Hollow on larger installations. Local businesses receive the compact terminal free of charge and only contribute to consumables and basic maintenance/service costs.

MUTUAL PLACE VISIBILITY

A network that benefits both sides

Hosts become visible as Echo Hollow locations inside the network, while Echo Hollow gains distributed city coverage. The relationship is designed as mutual place visibility rather than conventional advertising.

Who can apply?Public organisations · councils · community groups · universities · large venues · cafés · bookstores · independent local businesses
For local businessesThe compact Echo Hollow device is supplied free of charge. Local hosts only contribute to consumables and basic maintenance/service costs. In return, their location becomes discoverable within the Echo Hollow network — a low-pressure form of mutual place visibility for both the host and the platform.

SAFETY & PRIVACY

Share the place, not the person.

Echo Hollow is designed to keep attention on memories, places and time while reducing pressure to reveal personal identity.

IDENTITY

Preset identities, not personal profiles.

People choose from Echo Hollow identities and avatars rather than uploading a personal profile photo. Public posts may show a chosen Echo identity, while Anonymous posts hide it completely.

IMAGES

Places can be visible. Faces should not be.

Images are intended to show streets, landscapes, objects, food and spaces. Photos with identifiable faces are not accepted, helping the image stay connected to the place rather than the person.

LOCATION

You control how specific a place becomes.

Location is optional. Users can attach a place name, use an approximate neighbourhood, or leave location out entirely depending on what feels appropriate for the message.

COMMUNITY

Comments stay anonymous and can be reported.

Comments do not display identity. Posts or comments that feel harmful, inappropriate or unsafe can be reported, including by long-pressing a comment in the message view.

Moderation principleEcho Hollow prioritises shared experience over personal exposure. The goal is not to remove expression, but to reduce unnecessary identity signals around it.

Choose your Echo Hollow identity

Choose a nature or illustrated animal identity provided by Echo Hollow. Personal profile photos stay disabled to keep the space low-pressure and anonymous.

Account details

Your Echo Hollow username and avatar belong to your account and follow you across devices. Phone is optional, private, and kept only as a local prototype preference.

Privacy

Choose how Echo Hollow behaves by default. You can still change the visibility of each individual message before publishing.

Anonymous by defaultStart new messages in Anonymous mode instead of Public.
Place detailChoose how much location detail you prefer to attach to messages.
Hide my public identity in saved activityKeeps your Echo Hollow identity out of local saved-place activity summaries.

Notifications

Choose which Echo Hollow updates can reach you. These settings are stored locally in this prototype.

Email notificationsAllow Echo Hollow to use your account email for selected alerts.
Text / SMS notificationsAdd an optional phone number in Account to enable SMS.
New messages found for meAlerts when a message is selected for your New Messages feed.
Future message releasedAlerts when one of your time-capsule messages becomes visible.
Saved-place activityOccasional updates related to places represented in your saved messages.
